featured_reviews.name: Rohit Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Bike Riding Course - Highly Recommended!

I had a truly fantastic experience with this bike riding class! When I started, I didn't know how to ride a bike at all, and now, I’ve purchased and am confidently riding my own motorcycle. The transformation in skill and confidence is incredible.

The core of the class, particularly the intermediate traffic training, was extremely valuable. I gained practical, real-world experience that made me comfortable navigating busy roads. This instruction was instrumental in preparing me for daily commuting.

A massive thank you to Urvarshi Mam. She is exceptionally knowledgeable and her way of teaching is highly appreciated. She was helpful, patient, and truly ensured that every student grasped the necessary skills. Her expertise made all the difference.

I have only two minor pieces of constructive feedback:

I faced some difficulty with the schedule changes, as the morning class times were shifted to evening and night, which caused a small inconvenience.

The provided training bike, a Bajaj Avenger, was not self-start, meaning we often had to push it to get it going. While it taught us an old-school technique, a self-start option would definitely improve the flow of the lessons.

Despite these small logistical issues, everything else was excellent. The quality of instruction and the experience gained far exceeded my expectations. If you are looking to learn how to ride a bike confidently, this is the place to go!

featured_reviews.review_text: Very nice experience,highly recommended.I never rided a bicycle but now I can ride scooter confidently. Trainers are very good. They teach you very patiently.so whoever is reading my review don't think too much just join this scooter training school.

featured_reviews.name: Tejal Chache
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to join a 2 wheeler class, so I asked many people. Most of them told me that they had learned from here and suggested that I join Urvashi Motor Training School. After hearing that the classes are very good, I came here.

In my life, I had never even held a bicycle. On the first day itself, they gave me an electric scooty to learn. They walked beside me, holding the handle, and taught me. Only on the first day they taught me like that.

For a student like me, who didn’t even know how to ride a bicycle, on the second day they made me ride the scooty slowly by myself, keeping my feet down. After 2–3 days, slowly I started lifting my feet up in between and learned to balance the handle. In just 6 days I was able to lift my feet properly, balance, and ride the scooty.

The results of this class are really very good. They explain everything clearly and teach very well until you learn properly. If you are also looking for a two-wheeler class like me, then I will definitely recommend that you join Urvashi Motor Training School.

Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Sanghani
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Life-Changing Experience—Highly Recommend!

When I first heard about Rushabh’s 4-day automatic training, I literally laughed out loud. I told him that last year I had taken 20 sessions with a standard motor training school, and my legs still shook every time I sat in the driver's seat. Rushabh just calmly said, "Trust me. Give me your 4 days, and I promise you will be driving by yourself on the 5th day." Seeing so many motivating and positive reviews gave me a boost of confidence. I thought, since the 20 sessions didn't work, why not try 4 more days? It was the best decision I've ever made.

Here is how my intensive training (Jan 2nd - 5th 2026) went:

Day 1: The training was so intense, but I enjoyed every single minute of it.

Day 2: I drove all the way from Borivali to Juhu Beach and back! We took a small walk on the beach where I accidentally stepped into a deep hole in the wet sand. I went in halfway, had to be helped out, and lost one of my shoes inside! I am mentioning this because it’s a hilarious memory that I know we both will always cherish. On a personal level, it was such a happy moment for me because I actually drove that entire route myself. (see the attached photo to see how I went inside the sand & Juhu beach)

Day 3: This was more like a test of my testament and skills.

Day 4: By this point, it felt like I was just taking Rushabh out for a long drive with a 90-100 Speed! Haha. I also executed a parallel park in a very, very tough, tight space without hitting or dashing anybody (see the attached photo to see how I parked!).

I didn't even realise it, but by the 5th day, I could actually drive anywhere.

That said, with daily life chores, WFH, and managing two kids (especially a baby!), I wasn't able to go out much to practice. Over the last 5 months, I might not have even driven 5 times. Today, I decided to take a revision session, thinking I had forgotten everything and needed him to help me drive again. I was completely wrong. That 4-day training is so deeply instilled in my subconscious mind. Today, it just felt like we were roaming around on the road and joking about stuff.

Rushabh is a gem of a person who has changed so many lives, especially for women like me. I am 39 years old, had a phobia of even riding a bicycle, and never thought I would drive a vehicle. My boy is so proud of me, and he is incredibly happy knowing that I will be doing his school pick-ups and drop-offs, or just taking him out for a drive.

THE MOST IMPORTANT THING I ALMOST FORGOT TO MENTION: Till now, I HAVEN'T HONKED. His teaching is not like a typical driving school that tells you to honk as soon as anyone comes in front of you. He teaches real patience and road sense.

Deepest gratitude for you, Rushabh. You are amazing! Keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text: I attended Rushabh Sanghavi’s 4-day automatic car driving session and it was an excellent learning experience. His techniques helped me gain full control over the car, handle traffic confidently, drive on highways, and master parking and road judgment. He is highly disciplined, always reaches before time, and conducts each session with complete dedication. In just four days, I learned more practical driving skills than what most normal 15-day driving school programs offer. This course is truly effective and much better for anyone who wants to become a confident and safe driver. 🚗

featured_reviews.name: Margi Bikester
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was honestly super nervous about learning to drive ❤️ especially with all the stupid stereotypes around women drivers  the fact that this was my BRAND NEW car. I was lowkey stressed all the time.

And then I started learning with Rushabh.
This man doesn’t just teach you how to drive. He literally teaches you how to OWN your car. Like properly own it. Not be scared of it. Not hesitate. Just be in control.

He got me to drive at 80 and actually feel in control. He made me handle narrow streets without panicking.🫠 And the biggest thing I don’t feel stressed taking my car out anymore. That’s something I never thought I’d say. From day one, his focus was on building real confidence.
Not surface-level “you’ll be fine” confidence but the kind where you actually understand what you’re doing. He explained the internals of the car so I knew what I was driving, not just how to move it.
He pushed me out of my comfort zone (safely), so the fear just… disappeared. It was never about panic reactions it was always about awareness and control, and I loved that.

Also, he doesn’t just make you drive the same boring routes. He actually takes you to places you’d want to drive to which makes the whole experience so much better.

And one thing that really stood out not once did he tell me to honk. Not ONCE. In the middle of all the chaos. His whole “unhonking” mindset is honestly so refreshing and makes you a calmer, more aware driver.
And somehow, the whole experience is actually fun?? ❤️
My dad’s going to learn from him next and I’m actually excited for him 😄
From anxious and overthinking every move to calm, in control, and actually enjoying the drive.

featured_reviews.name: Ankesh Nerkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The training is well crafted and backed by years of driving experience. You can clearly get the flavour of it starting from day 1. The training is focused on you becoming more mindful/peaceful while driving. I don't see any of the major driving challenge that was not addressed/explained during the training. This has helped me drive my car more confidently.

The lesson on "WHEN AND HOW TO HONK ?" was the best part of whole training.
Rating: 5/5.

Go and experience it for your safe/smooth driving journey.

featured_reviews.name: Ashna Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience learning to drive a stick shift car in just 4 days, I went from being completely new to confidently driving on the road. Mr. Rushubh was incredibly patient, clear, and encouraging — which made all the difference. I not only learned the techniques but also gained real confidence behind the wheel. Highly recommend to anyone looking to master manual driving quickly and comfortably!

featured_reviews.name: Vaishnavi Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
I completed my driving lessons with Rushabh Sir in early April, and I’m writing this review only now because we travelled abroad shortly after. I wanted to wait until I had actually driven on my own before sharing an honest review — and I’m so glad I did.

When I returned to India and finally got behind the wheel, I genuinely surprised myself. Driving felt effortless and even enjoyable. That’s when I realised how much confidence I had built in just five days.

The course Rushabh Sir has designed is truly unique and very thoughtfully structured. It may feel a little unusual in the initial session, but as the course progresses, you understand the purpose behind every step.

What really makes this course stand apart, though, is Rushabh Sir himself. He is always punctual, incredibly patient, and gives every session the time it needs — never rushing, never cutting corners. He even suggested that I take an additional session in city traffic, considering the size of my car, so that I could drive independently without constantly worrying about scratches or dents.

These days, every service follows up repeatedly asking for reviews, but Rushabh Sir did not ask me even once. Instead, he told me I could reach out to him anytime, even after the course, if I had doubts or faced any issues on the road. That kind of dedication, sincerity, and selflessness is rare.

If you want to learn driving the right way, with someone who truly cares about helping you become a confident driver, I cannot recommend Rushabh Sir and 4 Day Automatic enough.

featured_reviews.name: Dhrumin Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
I completed this driving training very recently, and at first, it may sound impossible to believe but trust me, this 4-day training can teach you what many other driving schools may take weeks or even months to cover, and still not help you reach the same level of confidence and control.

Rushabh bhai is truly a gem of a person, always polite, extremely patient, and teaches you like a friend rather than just an instructor. What makes this training different is that it’s not only about learning how to drive; it’s about building confidence, control, discipline, and road awareness.

Unlike other driving schools where you only learn the basics of driving, here you gain lessons and habits that stay with you for a lifetime. Highly recommended for anyone who genuinely wants to become a confident and responsible driver.

featured_reviews.name: Naman Pandya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience learning to drive at this motor training school, and I genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better instructor than Mahesh Master. From day one, the entire learning process felt smooth, structured, and stress-free—especially for someone learning in an automatic car.

Mahesh Master is incredibly patient, calm, and professional. He has a rare ability to make you feel confident behind the wheel, even if you’re nervous or completely new to driving. Every concept—from basic controls to real-world road situations—was explained clearly and practically. He never rushes the lessons and ensures you fully understand each step before moving forward.

Learning in an automatic car made the experience even more comfortable, especially in traffic. The car provided by the school was well-maintained, clean, and easy to handle, which helped me focus entirely on driving rather than worrying about the vehicle. Mahesh Master also taught valuable tips for city driving, parking, lane discipline, and handling traffic calmly—things that truly matter once you’re on the road alone.

What stood out the most was his supportive teaching style. Mistakes are treated as learning opportunities, not reasons for pressure or criticism. His guidance boosted my confidence and helped me develop safe driving habits, not just pass a test.

Overall, this motor training school offers excellent value, quality instruction, and a very positive learning environment. If you’re looking to learn driving—especially automatic car driving—I highly recommend enrolling here and learning under Mahesh Master. You’ll not only learn how to drive, but also how to drive confidently and responsibly.
